parsed.explanation: Combined regime imposes national birth-sex passport/facility rules, entry refusal and possible lifetime fraud ineligibility for document discrepancy, and state school/college facility bans, binary definition, no statewide public-accommodations or state hate-crime protection, and documented national custody hormone denial and abuse. No trans-presentation criminalisation, police sweeps, or state violence is documented, and existing X passports remain valid, mitigating severity. Unremedied universal exposures place this below reduced-risk anchors.

entry_documents.exposure: Documented: discrepancy triggers refusal and possible material-misrepresentation lifetime ineligibility; reports of confiscation/blocking. New X passports stopped.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports remain valid until expiration; fraud finding requires four elements and is never automatic, with limited waivers.
entry_documents.interaction: Entry discrepancy can lead to refusal, investigation, detention and birth-sex placement, compounding custody exposure.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Documented national custody: hormone removal, conversion-therapy model, forced labour, beatings, solitary and sexual abuse reported; stopped counting trans prisoners.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: National hate-crime statute and courts exist, but no documented remedy altering custody practices; challenges unresolved.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Any entry, facility or fraud investigation can move traveller into this custody regime.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Documented: national bar on government-funded facilities by identity; state school bathrooms by birth certificate and binary law; some states criminalise use after refusal to leave.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Many states have no mapped ban; private facilities may be inclusive. Whether this state has a general adult public-building ban is not clearly documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Staff questioning in government buildings can trigger trespass exposure in criminalising states and outing; college extension remains uncertain.

care_services.exposure: Documented: state felony, 10 years, for providers giving blockers/hormones/surgery under 19; national orders target minor care and school social transition.
care_services.protection: Adult emergency and prescribed care not documented as barred; some national orders blocked or enjoined.
care_services.interaction: Guardian travelling with minor faces care denial and possible investigation of providers/teachers; adult traveller faces medication/custody interruption.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Documented: national binary executive order, counterterrorism strategy prioritising 'radically pro-transgender' groups, reward system using 'radical gender ideology', sports and school investigations.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: No documented trans-presentation offence or organised police sweeps in this state; several orders challenged or blocked.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: State threat framing legitimises facility/document enforcement and reduces practical recourse despite functioning courts.

minors_guardians.exposure: Documented: school bathroom by birth certificate, sports by birth sex, minor care felony for providers, possible prosecution over social transition facilitation.
minors_guardians.protection: No documented parental criminal liability for seeking care; local ordinances in two municipalities protect against discrimination.
minors_guardians.interaction: Minor's school, sport or care encounter can out family and trigger provider, school or law-enforcement involvement.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: State hate-crime law does not cover gender identity; no statewide public-accommodations recourse; low-support polling. No specific state violence incident documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: National hate-crime statute covers gender identity; national employment ruling; isolated local protections exist.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Without state recourse, harassment after outing may depend on national enforcement and local police discretion.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Documented complaints/litigation unresolved; passport policy upheld by Supreme Court Nov 2025; appeals court upheld licence refusal.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Civil-liberties suits pending, some orders enjoined, legal-aid FAQ guidance; documented legal-aid organisation exists.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Pending litigation creates uncertainty, not operative protection; traveller cannot rely on future relief during travel.

anchor_checks.comparison: Similar: unremedied birth-sex facility exposure, document checking and court confirmation without relief. This case adds entry fraud risk and custody abuse, but facility scope for adults is less clearly universal.

Lower: 0.45-A has government-building bathroom ban with one prosecuted assault and ordinary emergency care. Here national entry consequences, custody hormone removal/abuse and absent state recourse add severity.

Higher: 0.65-A has accepted foreign documents including X, identity facilities, corrected refusals and convictions. Here X issuance stopped, discrepancy can cause refusal/fraud finding, and remedies are not shown correcting facility or custody practices.

parsed.synthesis: Protections are partial and prospective: valid existing X passports, no presentation offence, national hate-crime law and litigation. Operative exposures are immediate: birth-sex federal facilities, state school/college rules, entry discrepancy leading to refusal or possible lifetime ineligibility, no state public-accommodations recourse, and severe documented custody practices. For minors, care and school/sport restrictions compound exposure. Interactions across border, facilities and custody make the regime materially riskier than a jurisdiction with only social friction.
